finding.claim: The caller workflow template passes `folders: docs` and filters on `docs/**` only. That overrides the openviking-sync action's default (`docs` and `.okf`) and differs from this repo's own `.github/workflows/openviking-sync.yaml`, and the skill never asks which folders to sync. A repository with a `.okf/` bundle, such as one using kmctl, gets it silently left out of OpenViking. Ask the operator which folders to sync. Drop `folders:` when the answer is the action's default, and build the `paths` filter from the same list.

fixes.change: Asks which folders to sync (default docs and .okf), drops folders from the template and filters on both; gives the real reason to push before pinning; says to add the caller in key order. Also makes each step-4 block one self-contained shell call.
